text.card: A star about 130 parsecs away, 4.3 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 4.3 solar radii and 1.77 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,200 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: HD 175541
quotes.card: HD 175541 is an 8th magnitude star with an exoplanetary companion in the constellation Serpens.
quotes.introduction: It has the proper name Kaveh, which was selected by Iran during the NameExoWorlds campaign as part of the 100th anniversary of the IAU.
